name: Pápasalamon (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and green in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pápasalamon: a green shield with fleurs-de-lis, a wavy stripe and crossed tools.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
